about_the_game:
1999
HAVENBROOK, UNITED STATES.

While investigating the disappearance of Isabelle Nox, journalist Janet Sheperd enters the forests of Havenbrook to document an abandoned structure hidden deep within the woods.

Inside the building, all contact is lost.

What remains are fragmented walkie-talkie reports, distorted recordings, and traces of a cult that once believed the forest could offer salvation. Instead, everyone who followed that path vanished.

As Janet explores the decaying complex, time begins to fracture. Voices overlap. Events repeat out of order. Some transmissions seem to come from the past, others from places that no longer exist.

To uncover what happened to Isabelle Nox, Janet must piece together the cult’s final days and understand why those who enter the forest never leave unchanged.
detailed_description:
Feature List

  • Truth is not written. It’s transmitted, Uncover what happened through voices that may already belong to the past.

  • Explore vast, environments, uncovering dark secrets through fragmented walkie-talkie reports and distorted radio transmissions

  • Intriguing, touching, and mature storytelling, told entirely through voices, interference, and broken communication.

  • A multi-layered narrative thriller, blending mystery, psychological horror, and temporal dislocation.

  • Switch between Lucas and Janet, experiencing the same events from different points in time through broken communication

  • You are not alone, Something remains in the shadows. Not a single pursuer, but fractured human shapes that surface when you least expect them.


Just Updated

At the moment, we are working on full support for the Xbox Controller, which will be available in the final version of Shadows of Deceit.

name: Shadows Of Deceit

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)/Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, Intel Core i7-4770K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with 4GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: AMD Radeon RX 470 (4 GB), AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT (4 GB), NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB), NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB)
  • Additional Notes: Estimated Performance (Setting Performance Priority): 1080p/45 fps. Frame rate drops may occur during more complex scenes.

short_description: Shadows of Deceit is a first-person psychological horror focused on narrative investigation and atmosphere. Players explore the forests of Havenbrook while documenting events on VHS and reconstructing the truth through fragmented walkie-talkie reports and distorted voices.
